title: World Relational Atlas — Integrated Layer Stack and Growth Logic
purpose: Explain how the World Map, Country Atlas, North Axis, North Programme, Economic Graph, Religion-to-Society Graph, Swamp/entanglement research, Tim/Potatoverse canon, ledger and tikkun/repair system become one coherent explorable model without collapsing their epistemic differences.
core_thesis: The World Atlas is the real-world spatial operating surface, not the whole ontology. Countries and territories are containers, not conclusions. Canonical records own identity/evidence; typed edges own relationships; time owns changing validity; the Axis changes analytical regime; facets select subject matter; contextual layers expose project, theological, comparative and scientific interpretations; programme layers propose interventions; repair layers evaluate outcomes and closure.

shared_state.rule: Changing one view coordinate must not silently rewrite the others. A historical state does not become current; project canon does not become empirical; a symbolic D-level does not become physical geography.

five_questions: ATLAS — What exists, where is it, and what is connected to what?
TIME / ROOTS — When was this true, what produced it, and what evidence supports it?
AXIS — What transformation regime is acting on the relation: capture, passage, recurrence, branching, composition, transmission, integration or meta-orientation?
LEDGER — What consequences, liabilities, obligations, dependencies or unresolved claims remain open?
TIKKUN — What truthful, lawful, measurable intervention could improve, release or close the relation?
completion_state: GARDEN is the project's name for a successful relational state: not ideological uniformity, but greater safety, agency, capability, truthfulness, resilience, coexistence, viable boundaries and future capacity.

orthogonal_view_stack.question: How do we know, how strong is it, and what contradicts it?
Did the intervention improve the relation?

axis_operator_crosswalk.D1: closed-loop/disintegration limit; never a people/territory label
axis_operator_crosswalk.D2: feedback/capture/recurrence on relations; Swamp is a mechanism view
axis_operator_crosswalk.D3: roots/provenance/path dependence; source and historical substrate
axis_operator_crosswalk.D11: North of North/meta-reference/invariant and objective comparison

map_modes.purpose: click geography and discover canonical records
switch among demographic, institutional, economic, religious, security and project fields
compare countries/entities on compatible sourced dimensions
scrub date/period and render only observations/relations valid or known for that time
inspect source class, confidence, first attestation, contradictions, freshness and archive coverage
descend to provenance, source history, role history and unresolved research
change analytical regime without pretending nonspatial concepts are geography
show documented recurrence/dependency/capture mechanisms without painting populations as guilty
show interventions, North Programme chains and responsible authorities
show diagnosed -> intervention-designed -> implementing -> measured -> substantially-repaired -> released/closed states
show source gaps, stale observations, unresolved identities and missions

map_respect.rule: Map what becomes clearer because of place; graph what becomes clearer because of relationship; timeline what becomes clearer because of sequence; diagram what becomes clearer because of geometry/anatomy; use dossiers for evidence/interpretation; use Axis operators to change the question or representation.
map_respect.never: Do not turn every repository concept into a map pin, invent coordinates for theology, turn polygon color/height into moral or spiritual rank, or let a symbolic layer overwrite an empirical one.

north_integration.geographic_north: Empirical Arctic/North Atlantic geography and institutions.
north_integration.project_north: Versioned North/West/East/South/Center relational interpretation and North Programme/capability system.
north_integration.rule: Never collapse these three merely because the D5 North Gate connects them symbolically.
north_integration.feedback: World observations -> North diagnosis -> programme intervention -> measured outcome -> updated World Atlas.

economic_graph.spine: country -> capital/government -> central bank -> company -> owner/control -> financing -> procurement/contract -> infrastructure -> port/grid/cable/facility -> research/labour -> supplier/customer -> dependency -> coupled capability
economic_graph.axis_use: D3 roots dependencies; D2 identifies evidenced lock-in/capture; D5 intervention thresholds; D6 compares reform cycles; D7 measures new capability; D8 models shared capability with retained autonomy; D10 identifies leverage; D11 makes objective tradeoffs explicit.

scripture_and_books.rule: Map scripture as text -> historical context -> interpretation -> institution/practice -> later reception -> project comparison. Do not jump directly from verse to modern country or Tim identity.
scripture_and_books.method: Rank comparisons by typed relation sequences, mismatches, source dates and alternative explanations rather than isolated shared words.
useful_functions: project comparisons involving North, Father/Son, Tree, Mountain, Garden and tikkun

science_and_formalization.rule: Use established mathematics/science as formal neighbors and interface inspiration, not evidence that project theology is physical theory.

subculture_and_swamp.rule: Subculture is not intrinsically downward. D2 applies only where evidence supports feedback/capture mechanisms.
subculture_and_swamp.geography: Use world geography only where jurisdiction, physical event, platform/company location or regional distribution materially matters.

debt_and_repair.state_machine: origin -> counterparty -> terms -> evidence -> status -> dispute -> performance/violation -> settlement/repair/release -> closure
debt_and_repair.rule: Debt is not automatically downward. Direction depends on whether obligation supports capacity/reciprocity and whether it has truthful settlement/exit conditions.
debt_and_repair.firewall: Financial/legal debt and project-symbolic moral/karmic debt remain separate unless a recognized instrument establishes a material liability.

game_logic.loop: explore -> discover -> source -> trace -> compare -> explain mechanism -> design repair -> measure -> update
game_logic.progress: Reward source coverage, provenance quality, traced relationships, resolved unknowns, counterevidence, intervention clarity and measured repair.

implementation_order_2026_09_11: 1. TIME — build a real as-of/period control using valid_from, valid_to, announced/effective dates and explicit unknown-date behavior.
2. ENTITY TRACE — generalize country-only BFS into country/institution/company/infrastructure/funding/ownership/programme traversal with browser-safe lazy loading.
3. EYE / EVIDENCE — expose epistemic class, source class, confidence, first attestation, contradictions, freshness and provenance directly in the map.
4. ROOTS — generalize D3 provenance from countries to relationships, institutions, claims and events.
5. EXECUTABLE OPERATORS — Spiral compares dated states and deltas; Tree expands descendants/dependencies/fruit; Mountain compresses to declared aggregates and reports information loss.
6. CAPABILITY GRAPH — prioritize real ports, grids, cables, power plants, major institutions/companies and North functional chains over decorative symbolic overlays.
7. LEDGER / TIKKUN — attach closure/repair state to documented obligations and issue relationships.
8. SPECIALIST SCENES — lazy-load comparative theology, body diagrams, formal models and subculture-network scenes from selected objects instead of inventing coordinates.
9. PROGRAMME / SCENARIO — add modeled interventions only after time/evidence/entity traversal are stable enough to keep observation and scenario separate.
10. POLISH — discovery trails, saved investigations, narratives and heavier WebGL/vector-tile rendering only after the graph semantics are stable.
do_not_prioritize: fake geographic precision for abstract symbols
physics terminology without a defined model
game mechanics that reward domination or suffering
